name: A Bloodstained Journal Page
summary: A torn, bloodstained parchment examined during the investigation into Stalvan Mistmantle. A few words remain legible through the thick blood, and Commander Althea Ebonlocke asks that its handwriting be checked.

sections.title: A Grim Piece of Evidence
sections.body: Commander Althea Ebonlocke keeps a vigilant watch over Darkshire and asks for the handwriting on this torn, blood-spattered page to be examined. Despite the thick blood, a few words remain legible enough for Clerk Daltry to compare with the Town Registry.

sections.title: Handwriting and Guilt
sections.body: To remove any shred of doubt before enacting justice, Commander Ebonlocke relies on Clerk Daltry, keeper of Darkshire's Town Hall registry. Years spent archiving municipal signatures made Daltry an authority on local penmanship. Upon examining the bloodstained leaf against municipal records, Daltry definitively authenticates the hand as Stalvan's, sealing the tutor's guilt.

faq.q: What is this bloodstained journal page?
faq.answer: It is a torn, bloodstained leaf associated with the investigation into Stalvan Mistmantle. Commander Althea Ebonlocke asks Clerk Daltry to examine its handwriting.

faq.q: Who can confirm who wrote this page?
faq.answer: Clerk Daltry in Darkshire's Town Hall. As the keeper of the town registry, he compares the script on the page against old signatures on file to verify Stalvan's handwriting.

faq.q: Why does Althea Ebonlocke need this page examined?
faq.answer: Commander Althea has watched Stalvan for some time and wants Clerk Daltry to compare the page with the Town Registry. She needs to establish whether both were written by the same hand.

faq.q: Where does this page lead in the investigation?
faq.answer: The page is taken to Clerk Daltry in Darkshire so he can compare its handwriting with the registry. The investigation continues with Commander Ebonlocke after his examination.

angles.text: For protectors of the realm, this grim document is evidence examined by Darkshire's Night Watch during the investigation.
